title: 映像メディア処理
subtitle: Visual Media Processing
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	Learn a wider range of image processing algorithms.
(2)	Learn how to edit movies and videos.
(3)	Learn how to create 3D CG animations.
(4)     Learn how to create digital contents for projection mapping.
(5)     Learn and practice projection mapping.
advice: Students are required to install 3D CG software of Blender on their computer.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge about computer graphics is required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand various image processing algorithms.
Be able to edit videos and make short movies.
Be able to create 3D CG videos.
Be able to create 3D content for projection mapping.
Be able to carry out projection mapping event.

              Students will:
(1)	Learn a wider range of image processing algorithms.
(2)	Learn how to edit movies and videos.
(3)	Learn how to create 3D CG animations.
(4)     Learn how to create digital contents for projection mapping.
(5)     Learn and practice projection mapping.
